_comment: Class abilities. type is a display category (nuke/heal/dot/hot/buff/debuff/cc/pet/utility/passive/discipline); effects drive the mechanics. cost is paid from resource (endurance or mana). Passives name the skill they represent; their level must match the class skill unlock.

abilities.name: Iron Challenge
abilities.description: Bellow a challenge that makes your target attack you instead of your allies.

abilities.name: Rising Kick
abilities.description: A snapping kick that deals light damage.

abilities.name: Pommel Crack
abilities.description: Crack your foe with the pommel of your weapon, stunning it briefly. Fails on foes well above your level.

abilities.name: Dodge
abilities.description: Passive: a chance to dodge melee attacks. Improves with use.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description: Passive: a chance to parry melee attacks. Improves with use.

abilities.name: Rallying Cry
abilities.description: Steel yourself with a war cry, recovering some health and endurance.

abilities.name: Double Attack
abilities.description: Passive: a chance to swing twice each round. Improves with use.

abilities.name: Cleaving Blow
abilities.description: A heavy overhead blow that deals solid damage and draws attention.

abilities.name: Bulwark Stance
abilities.description: Defensive discipline: take 40% less melee damage for 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Provoking Roar
abilities.description: Roar at every foe within 15 meters that is already fighting, drawing their anger to you.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.description: Passive: a chance to block a melee attack and strike back at once. Improves with use.

abilities.name: Battle Fury
abilities.description: Offensive discipline: deal 35% more melee damage with a higher critical chance for 20 seconds.

abilities.name: Stalwart Resolve
abilities.description: Refuse to fall: instantly recover 30% of your health.

abilities.name: Earthsplitter
abilities.description: Drive your weapon down with ground-shaking force. A stronger rank of Cleaving Blow.

abilities.name: Unbroken Wall
abilities.description: Defensive discipline: take 65% less melee damage for 10 seconds. A stronger rank of Bulwark Stance.

abilities.name: Warlord's Challenge
abilities.description: A stronger rank of Iron Challenge that also adds a large burst of extra anger.
